# sigma_connection_path_grant (Resource)

Grants a permission on a specific connection-path node (database/schema/table). Composite ID `<connection_path_id>:<grant_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Grant a team `usage` on a sub-tree (database/schema/table) of a connection.
# Path UUIDs are resolved via data.sigma_connection_path from a DOT-joined
# warehouse path (DATABASE.SCHEMA.TABLE) that matches a synced catalog path.
data "sigma_connection_path" "customers_table" {
  connection_id = sigma_connection.snowflake.id
  path          = "ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.CUSTOMERS"
}

resource "sigma_connection_path_grant" "analysts_can_query_customers" {
  connection_path_id = data.sigma_connection_path.customers_table.id
  team_id            = sigma_team.analysts.id
  permission         = "usage"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_path_id` (String) Connection path UUID. Use the `sigma_connection_path` data source to look up paths.
- `permission` (String) Either `usage` or `annotate`.

### Optional

- `member_id` (String) Exactly one of `member_id` or `team_id` must be set.
- `team_id` (String) Exactly one of `member_id` or `team_id` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `grant_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_connection_path_grant.example '<connection_path_id>:<grant_id>'
```
